tools.name: search_records
tools.description: Finds companies or contacts by name, or filters a page of deals by title. Use to resolve a named record before reading or proposing changes. Continue while has_more is true, even on an empty page.

query.description: Company/contact name or deal title as the person said it

stage.description: Only for deals: keep one stage

limit.description: Rows per page, 1 to 5 (default 3); use 1 if the output is too large

cursor.description: Continue with next_cursor from the prior result; omit for the first page

tools.name: get_record
tools.description: Reads the key facts of one company, contact or deal, without private notes. Use after finding a record when the person asks about it or wants a change.

tools.name: pipeline_overview
tools.description: Summarises deals by stage and currency, plus deals unchanged for over 14 days. Use to review pipeline health. Dates filter deal creation, not closing. A partial result covers at most 500 active deals.

from.description: Start of the range as the person said it; the app resolves it

to.description: End of the range as the person said it; the app resolves it

tools.name: list_activities
tools.description: Lists recent activities, optionally for one company, contact or deal. Use to show what happened lately, or before proposing a new activity so you do not duplicate one.

entity.description: Limit to one kind of record

limit.description: Rows per page, 1 to 5 (default 3); use 1 if the output is too large

cursor.description: Continue with next_cursor from the prior result; omit for the first page

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: Lists invoices with status and amount due, optionally for one company. Use when the person asks what is unpaid, overdue or billed.

limit.description: Rows per page, 1 to 5 (default 3); use 1 if the output is too large

cursor.description: Continue with next_cursor from the prior result; omit for the first page

tools.name: propose_activity
tools.description: Queues a call, email, meeting or note for approval. Use when the person describes something that happened or should happen next. It never saves directly; a person approves it in the app.

title.description: Short summary the person would recognise

entity_id.description: Id of that company, contact or deal

note.description: Details to keep with the activity

scheduled_at.description: When it should happen, as the person said it

tools.name: propose_deal_stage
tools.description: Queues a legal deal stage change for human approval. Use when the person wants to move a deal or mark it won or lost. Read the current deal first; a lost deal needs a reason.

lost_reason.description: Reason when marking the deal lost

tools.name: propose_deal
tools.description: Queues a new deal for approval, optionally linked to a company. Use when the person wants to add an opportunity. It is not created until a person approves it.

value.description: Amount in major units, for example 40000000

currency.description: Organization currency; omit to use its configured currency

close_date.description: Expected close, as the person said it

tools.name: propose_company
tools.description: Queues a new company for approval. Use when the person asks to add a company that search_records cannot find. It is not created until a person approves it.

name.description: Company name as the person said it

tools.name: open_record
tools.description: Opens a company, contact, deal or invoice page after the person asks to see it. Refuses navigation while a form has unsaved changes or a dialog is open.

id.description: Record id; omit to open the list
